q-111983.name: Question 3
q-111983.worked_solution:
Firstly, since $|-a|=|a|,$ we can write our expression as

$$
|9a|.
$$

Then, we distribute the absolute value over the multiplication, and simplify:

$$
\begin{aligned}|9a| & = \\ |9\cdot a| & = \\ |9|\cdot |a| & = \\ 9\cdot |a| & = \\ 9|a|\end{aligned}
$$

q-78933.name: Question 5
q-78933.worked_solution:
Firstly, since $|-a|=|a|,$ we can write our expression as

$$
|\frac{5p}{2}|.
$$

Then, we distribute the absolute value over the division, and simplify:

$$
\begin{aligned}|\frac{5p}{2}| & = \\ \frac{|5p|}{|2|} & = \\ \frac{|5p|}{2} & = \\ \frac{|5\cdot p|}{2} & = \\ \frac{|5|\cdot |p|}{2} & = \\ \frac{5|p|}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

q-78907.worked_solution:

$$

$$
